newsitem.title: USA: First Midwest raises payout, sets stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: First Midwest raises payout, sets stock dividend.

text.p: First Midwest Financial Inc said on Monday it will increase its quarterly cash dividend to $0.135 per share from $0.11.
The company also said it will pay a 50 percent stock dividend.

The 50-percent stock dividend will give stockholders one share for every two shares held on the record date. Both the cash dividend and the stock dividend will be paid on about Jan 2, 1997, to stockholders of record on Dec 16, 1996, the company said.
Fractional shares created by the stock dividend will be paid in cash, it said.

Assuming that First Midwest keeps its dividend payout at the newly announced amount as anticipated, future dividends will be declared at the rate of $0.09 per share to reflect the dividend, the company added. --Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787
